item.title: Trading Fix-It Prompts for Role-Based Code Reviews in Claude

item.title: Practical Agent Design Lessons from the OpenAI Guide

item.description: Deploying AI agents without workspace structure scatters outputs. Mirroring an org chart in directories and writing explicit SOPs stabilizes quality.
